summary: DroZon backend tested end-to-end via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 24/24 pytest cases passed covering root health, Drones CRUD (create/list/get/update/delete + 404s + Pydantic validation), bulk-seed idempotency, Missions create/list/filter/update/404/validation, Alerts create/list/filter/ack/404/validation, and Stats shape.

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary keys in updates dict without validation (typed via Dict[str, Any]) — no schema enforcement on partial updates; permits writing unknown fields to Mongo.
Same as above — no update schema, allows arbitrary keys.
Payload typed as List[Dict[str, Any]] — no Pydantic validation on individual items; bad data could be inserted when DB is empty.
Deprecated FastAPI startup/shutdown event API — use lifespan handlers instead.
Returns 200 instead of 201 on creation (minor REST convention).

action_items: Optional: add Pydantic DroneUpdate/MissionUpdate models for PUT endpoints to prevent arbitrary field writes.
Optional: validate bulk-seed items with Pydantic (List[DroneCreate]).
Optional: migrate deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
Optional: return 201 for POST create endpoints for REST correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is only 271 lines, well-structured, uses env vars, excludes _id in Mongo projections — good.
CORS uses env CORS_ORIGINS defaulting to '*' — OK for dev.
PUT endpoints accept Dict[str, Any] with no schema — potential for junk fields in DB (non-blocking).
Startup/shutdown event handler is deprecated in newer FastAPI (use lifespan).
All routes correctly prefixed with /api and mounted before CORS middleware — ingress routing OK.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed drones/missions/alerts created during tests; drones cleaned up in teardown. Missions & alerts have no DELETE endpoint — TEST_-prefixed rows remain in DB (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_drozon_api.py — 24 cases, run via `pytest backend/tests/test_drozon_api.py -v`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Missions and alerts intentionally have no DELETE endpoint, so cleanup of those TEST_ rows is skipped. If retesting, `test_bulk_seed_idempotent` requires DB to be non-empty (satisfied because tests create a drone earlier in the class).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
